changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: WITH numbered AS ( SELECT id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at)::INT AS yr, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) ORDER BY id) AS seq FROM patient WHERE mrn IS NULL ) UPDATE patient p SET mrn = 'MRN-' || numbered.yr || '-' || LPAD(numbered.seq::TEXT, 5, '0') FROM numbered WHERE p.id = numbered.id;

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: WITH numbered AS ( SELECT id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at)::INT AS yr, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) ORDER BY id) AS seq FROM sale WHERE bill_no IS NULL ) UPDATE sale s SET bill_no = 'BILL-' || numbered.yr || '-' || LPAD(numbered.seq::TEXT, 5, '0') FROM numbered WHERE s.id = numbered.id;

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: WITH numbered AS ( SELECT id, encounter_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM visit_date)::INT AS yr, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY encounter_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM visit_date) ORDER BY id ) AS seq FROM visit WHERE encounter_no IS NULL ) UPDATE visit v SET encounter_no = numbered.encounter_type || '-' || numbered.yr || '-' || LPAD(numbered.seq::TEXT, 5, '0') FROM numbered WHERE v.id = numbered.id;
